text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On this day as well, while training with 
Sakura Laurel—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
choice_data_list: Are you okay!? Does your leg hurt?
Are you okay!? Does your leg hurt?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Yes. It seems to be the usual, once again.
choice_data_list: 大丈夫！？脚が痛むか？
大丈夫！？脚が痛むの？
choice_data_list_en: Are you okay!? Does your leg hurt?
Are you okay!? Is your leg hurting?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After her debut race, Sakura Laurel came 
to me with a certain report.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems pain flares up whenever more 
pressure than usual is applied to her 
legs, such as when bracing herself. The 
pain is said to be particularly acute 
after races.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
It's not that I can't walk, but... It's 
starting to heat up, kind of giving off a 
warning sign.
choice_data_list: Let's ask at the hospital again next time.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Right. Rather than making crude guesses, 
it's safer to seek expert advice.
choice_data_list: 今度また病院で聞いてみよう
choice_data_list_en: Let's ask again at the hospital next time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Previously, the reason for Sakura Laurel's 
fragile legs was attributed to delayed 
physical development.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I should also run another checkup to see 
if the situation has changed since then.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And while I was contacting the hospital 
and putting various documents together in 
the Trainer's office...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: E-Excuse me.
choice_data_list: Sakura Chiyono O? What's wrong?
Sakura Chiyono O? Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, um. Do you happen to know Laurel-san's 
Trainer?
choice_data_list: サクラチヨノオーか、どうしたんだ？
サクラチヨノオー？どうしたの？
choice_data_list_en: Sakura Chiyono O? What's going on?
Sakura Chiyono O? What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
That Laurel-san's legs have been hurting 
from time to time...
choice_data_list: I'm taking consultations.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
choice_data_list: 相談は受けているよ
choice_data_list_en: I've been listening to their concerns.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Still, Laurel-san, you'll be entering 
the Classic division pretty soon too, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
That throbbing pain unique to inflammation 
hurts so badly you just want to swap out 
your legs entirely.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...Even so. Even through all that... I 
just couldn't give up on my racing 
dream...!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Besides Laurel-san, I know of another 
Umamusume who was said to have 'glass 
legs.'"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"That person and I ran together. In the 
race everyone dreams of—the Japanese 
Derby."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Both of them poured everything they had 
into it.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Even if it brings pain. Even if my future 
doesn't flourish, I don't care. ...I want 
to run in this very moment. I, too—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...However, what's broken can never truly 
return to the way it was.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Once broken, time can never be turned 
back. The price must be paid."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...And yet, I can't suppress the passion 
I've poured into this single race.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
There are times when you just can't 
control yourself anymore...!
choice_data_list:
...Are you worried Laurel might end up 
like that?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
choice_data_list: ……ローレルがそうなるか、心配？
choice_data_list_en: ...Are you worried Laurel will end up like that?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yes...!
choice_data_list: ケガはさせたくないよな
ケガはさせたくないよね
choice_data_list_en: I don't want you getting hurt.
I really don't want you getting hurt.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
That's why I wanted to talk to you about 
it.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Taking an extended break to prevent injury 
is by no means running away.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
You're allowed to choose a different path 
to relieve the pain and anxiety you're 
carrying right now.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...In order to keep running for a long 
time to come.
choice_data_list:
Taking that into account, I'll go with the 
choice she wants.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
choice_data_list: それも踏まえて彼女が望む選択をするよ
choice_data_list_en: Taking that into account, I'll go with the choice she wants.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Even if that path leads to danger?
choice_data_list:
Because I can't take away your reason and 
purpose for running.

Because I can't take away the reason and 
meaning you all have for running

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
choice_data_list: だって君たちが走る理由や意味を奪えない
だって貴方たちが走る理由や意味を奪えない
choice_data_list_en: Because I can't take away the reason or meaning behind why you run.
Because I can't take away the reason or meaning behind why you run.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ah...
choice_data_list: 君たちがたった1度の夢を目指したように
貴方たちがたった1度の夢を目指したように
choice_data_list_en: Just like how you guys aimed for that once-in-a-lifetime dream.
Just as you chased that once-in-a-lifetime dream.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
choice_data_list: ...Sorry, even after you worried about me.

...Sorry, even after you were worried 
about me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...No, I'm sorry. That was unsolicited 
advice.
choice_data_list: ……ごめんな、心配してくれたのに
……ごめんね、心配してくれたのに
choice_data_list_en: ……Sorry, even after you worried about me.
……Sorry, after you went out of your way to worry about me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...It was the same for us.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"The reason we ran was entirely for our 
own dreams."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Having that snatched away from under my 
nose is something I wouldn't have even 
wanted to imagine back then."
choice_data_list:
Still, I'll make sure to take good care of 
her legs, too.

Still, I'll make sure to take good care of 
her legs, too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: …………You really are my Trainer, after all.
choice_data_list: でも彼女の脚も大事にしてみせるよ
でも彼女の脚も大事にしてみせるよ
choice_data_list_en: Still, I promise I'll look out for her legs too.
Still, I promise I'll look out for her legs too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
choice_data_list: それにローレルの走りは、俺の夢なんだ
それにローレルの走りは、私の夢なんだ
choice_data_list_en: Besides, seeing you run, Laurel, is my dream.
Besides, seeing you run, Laurel, is my dream.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Fufu, is that so?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Aw man, now I have no idea when I should 
jump in.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Guess I'll do this later.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Then, on another day. We went to the 
hospital and were told that while Sakura 
Laurel's leg hadn't worsened, she still 
required continued observation."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
It seems my legs are still in the middle 
of growing.
choice_data_list:
It hasn't gotten any worse, so I can keep 
doing my best.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Indeed. ......
choice_data_list: 悪化もしていないから、引き続き頑張れるよ
choice_data_list_en: It hasn't gotten any worse, so we can keep giving it our all.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. If my legs ever got completely 
better... How do you think I'd run?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"An abstract answer is totally fine. I 
just want to solidify my ideals!"
choice_data_list:
Then a run fit to win the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
That goes without saying! You know, like 
running so low you crawl, or running like 
you're flying!
choice_data_list: じゃあ『凱旋門賞』に勝つ走り？
choice_data_list_en: Then running worthy of winning the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
So in other words, that's the direction to 
take when evolving Sakura Laurel's running 
style. As I ponder this with my hand on my 
chin...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: I can understand why you'd be troubled.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'm gonna use these eyes of 
mine to go watch all kinds of running!
choice_data_list: Make use of your eyes?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Yes! Observing is my specialty!
choice_data_list: 目を活かす？
choice_data_list_en: Play to your eyes?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I'll go check out the races for Hishi 
Ama-chan, Hayahide-chan... and Brian-chan!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
So I figured I shouldn't let this period 
go to waste, and use the time to study 
instead.
choice_data_list: I think that's a great idea.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Thank you♪
choice_data_list: とてもいい案だと思うよ
choice_data_list_en: I think that's a wonderful idea.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...... That's why, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"If I ever look like I'm giving in to the 
pain or fear, please give me a good slap 
on the back and tell me to chase my ideal 
run!"
choice_data_list:
Will a day like that ever come in the 
first place...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel is a strong horse girl. When 
I told her that taking precautions to 
recover is fine, and that I have zero fear 
of her spirit breaking...
choice_data_list: まずそんな日がくるかな……？
choice_data_list_en: Will a day like that even come to begin with...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Even so, indeed.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Because I know you will cherish the way I 
run."
